title: Taskflow Agent finds an HTML encoding bypass in Orchard CMS
summary: Orchard Core StringValuesValue writes query, header and form values to Liquid output without using the encoder, enabling reflected XSS when affected templates render those values.
ai_role: GHSL explicitly credits discovery to its Taskflow Agent and manual verification by Jaroslav Lobačevski. Reported 2026-03-31 and fixed 2026-04-01 before a published release. No CVE is listed.
classification_note: GHSL describes a conditional XSS risk requiring affected Liquid templates; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL says the vulnerability was fixed on 2026-04-01 before a published release; a fixed release number is not stated.
